organisms.name: Grass
organisms.fact: Grass grows from the bottom of its leaves, so it keeps growing even after it is nibbled.

organisms.name: Wildflower
organisms.fact: Wildflowers make sweet nectar and bright petals to attract bees and other insects.

organisms.name: Oak tree
organisms.fact: A big oak tree can grow thousands of acorns in a year, a feast for many animals.

organisms.name: Berry bush
organisms.fact: A berry bush wraps its seeds in sweet fruit so animals will eat them and carry the seeds away.

organisms.name: Pondweed
organisms.fact: Pondweed grows underwater and gives off the oxygen that fish breathe.

organisms.name: Water lily
organisms.fact: A water lily's big flat leaves float on top of the water, where they catch lots of sunlight.

organisms.name: Seaweed
organisms.fact: Seaweed is a kind of algae. It makes its own food from sunlight, just like plants on land.

organisms.name: Cactus
organisms.fact: A cactus stores water in its thick stem, so it can live for months without rain.

organisms.name: Desert flower
organisms.fact: After a rare desert rain, seeds that waited for years sprout and bloom within days.

organisms.name: Rabbit
organisms.fact: A rabbit's front teeth never stop growing, so it chews all day to wear them down.
organisms.diet: Rabbits eat grass, clover and other plants.

organisms.name: Cricket
organisms.fact: A cricket 'sings' by rubbing its wings together.
organisms.diet: Crickets eat grass, leaves and seeds.

organisms.name: Caterpillar
organisms.fact: A caterpillar spends almost all its time eating, then turns into a butterfly or moth.
organisms.diet: Caterpillars eat leaves.

organisms.name: Squirrel
organisms.fact: Squirrels forget where they buried some acorns, and those acorns grow into new oak trees.
organisms.diet: Squirrels eat nuts, seeds and acorns.

organisms.name: Snail
organisms.fact: A snail carries its shell like a backpack and can pull its whole body inside.
organisms.diet: Snails eat soft plants and algae.

organisms.name: Ant
organisms.fact: An ant can carry things many times heavier than itself.
organisms.diet: Harvester ants collect seeds and carry them to their nest.

organisms.name: Green sea turtle
organisms.fact: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres, then come back to lay eggs on the beach where they hatched.
organisms.diet: Green sea turtles graze on seagrass and seaweed.

organisms.name: Kangaroo rat
organisms.fact: A kangaroo rat can live without ever drinking. It gets its water from the seeds it eats.
organisms.diet: Kangaroo rats eat seeds.

organisms.name: Mouse
organisms.fact: A mouse uses its whiskers to feel its way around in the dark.
organisms.diet: Mice eat seeds, berries and insects.

organisms.name: Fox
organisms.fact: A fox can hear a mouse squeaking under the snow and pounce right on it.
organisms.diet: Foxes eat small animals, berries and insects.

organisms.name: Shrimp
organisms.fact: Some shrimp work as cleaners and nibble the bugs off bigger fish.
organisms.diet: Shrimp eat tiny plants and bits of food that drift past.

organisms.name: Crab
organisms.fact: A crab walks sideways because of the way its legs bend.
organisms.diet: Crabs eat seaweed, shellfish and bits of dead animals.

organisms.name: Carp
organisms.fact: A carp can live for more than twenty years.
organisms.diet: Carp eat water plants, snails and insects.

organisms.name: Duck
organisms.fact: A duck's feathers are oily, so water rolls right off them.
organisms.diet: Ducks eat water plants, snails and insects.

organisms.name: Owl
organisms.fact: An owl can turn its head almost all the way round to look behind it.
organisms.diet: Owls eat mice, squirrels and other small animals.

organisms.name: Eagle
organisms.fact: An eagle's eyes are so sharp that it can spot a small animal from very far away.
organisms.diet: Eagles eat snakes, rabbits, mice and other animals.

organisms.name: Snake
organisms.fact: A snake swallows its food whole.
organisms.diet: Snakes eat frogs, mice, lizards and other small animals.

organisms.name: Frog
organisms.fact: A frog catches its food with a sticky tongue in a split second.
organisms.diet: Frogs eat insects, snails and worms.

organisms.name: Otter
organisms.fact: An otter's thick fur keeps it warm and dry in the water.
organisms.diet: Otters eat fish, frogs and crabs.

organisms.name: Small fish
organisms.fact: Many small fish swim in big groups, called schools, to stay safe.
organisms.diet: Small fish eat shrimp and other tiny animals.

organisms.name: Octopus
organisms.fact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
organisms.diet: Octopuses eat crabs, shrimp and fish.

organisms.name: Tuna
organisms.fact: Tuna are among the fastest swimmers in the sea.
organisms.diet: Tuna eat small fish and squid.

organisms.name: Shark
organisms.fact: A shark loses thousands of teeth in its life, and new ones keep growing.
organisms.diet: Sharks eat fish, octopuses and sea turtles.

organisms.name: Lizard
organisms.fact: Some lizards can drop their tail to escape, and it grows back.
organisms.diet: Lizards eat ants, crickets and other insects.

organisms.name: Scorpion
organisms.fact: Scorpions glow bright blue-green under a special light.
organisms.diet: Scorpions eat insects and spiders.
